reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in their DM: noted that Dock 14 is now their dock for Marrow Fieldworks pickups, and that I'll keep it between us.

- **Where the note lives:** only in that DM thread. I didn't save it to GBrain or my persistent memory, because both are read when I answer other members. Storing it there could carry it into their conversations.
- **What I checked first:** GBrain had nothing on a Marrow Fieldworks pickup dock. Its search is running keyword-only right now, so it may have missed differently worded notes.
- **One snag:** my first attempt to send the reply failed (`user_not_found`), because I passed the DM channel id to the direct-message tool. I re-sent it with the channel posting tool, and it went through.

No other action was needed.
